text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, Aston
Machan
and I are walking through the
shopping district
when...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmmm? Is that...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's just as I feared. Look, Trainer. It's the
soaring
bandit, Toby the Trickster!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze upwards, I spot a
large black
kite leisurely circling in the
sky.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Toby the Trickster is a notorious villain. I
know
because I'm one of his victims.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper A
text_block_list.text:
Here we are, one piping-hot ham cutlet!
Careful
not to burn your tongue!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Hammy hammy cutl—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Agh!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew what had hit me, the
feathered
fiend was soaring off with my
ham cutlet in his
beak. Terrible, right?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely. I never forget a face,
especially when
it comes to food
bandits.
choice_data_list: What if it's the wrong kite?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, enough chat. The culprit has nearly
flown
out of sight.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is a mission for Machan the Ultra
Spy and her
trusty sidekick!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let's roll!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's odd. I'm sure he was flying
towards
this park...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It won't be easy to keep up with an
airborne
target. I open my mouth to
suggest we give up for
now, but just
then...
Squeak... Squeak, squeak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear what sounds like a number of
high-pitched
voices screeching earnestly
from somewhere high
above.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, look up there.

text_block_list.name: Kite Chicks
text_block_list.text: Squeak, squeak! Squeak, squeak, squeak!

text_block_list.name: Toby the Kid
text_block_list.text: Peep, peep... Heeeee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's eyes are locked onto
the nest of
the allegedly ham-thieving
kite, high up a tree.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Toby the Trickster is
actually Tobi
the Mom.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That explains why she stole my food...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: She must have been desperate to provide for her children. Sniffle.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I might hate the crime, but I mustn't hate
the
bird...
Thank you, Tobi. You've
taught me an important
lesson I'll never
forget.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to look at that incident
from a
different perspective—my cutlet
wasn't stolen,
but passed along.
choice_data_list: Are you ready to forget your ham cutlet grudge yet?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy it fed some little ones, and I'm
sure the
cutlet would be okay with it
too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's time for Machan the Ultra Spy to go
back to
being a lovely mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's time for Machan the Ultra Spy to go
back to
being a lovely mascot.
choice_data_list: I hope it grows up safe and sound.
I hope it grows up safe and sound, too.
Shall we pick up some replacement ham cutlets on the way home?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Hold on just a second there.
choice_data_list: I hope it grows up safe and sound.
I hope it grows up safe and sound, too.
Shall we pick up some replacement ham cutlets on the way home?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If all of those mini-Tobis grow up as
strong as
their mom, won't we have a
whole gaggle of
food-snatching bandits
on our hands?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
One is trouble enough, but if you add
the minis
into the mix... Oh no.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like it'll be Machan the Ultra
Teacher's
turn to step up next.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We'll need to come back sometime soon
to teach
them some manners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that Aston Machan
might
actually have what it takes to
teach birds. All I
can do is hope for the
best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, your treat? Yay. You're so generous,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ham cutlets are much tastier when
they're free.
Lucky me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now, how many should we get? Should
we just
buy everything they've got?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Kehehe. I'm just teasing. I know we're
eating ham
cutlet, but I'm not planning
on becoming Podgy
Machan, so let's
keep the portions reasonable.
choice_data_list: At least keep it in the single digits?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A crafty Aston Machan and I enjoy some
freshly
fried ham cutlets (on me), before
heading back to
the academy.
